Intro: Oh god, oh no. That idiot! When could my sister have…I need to find her. She's seeking something that could get her killed!
That pale man…I've been visited by him before. He warned me what he would do to her. I'm scared, Chef. I'm scared of that thing more than anything.
I know something is wrong with Eve, but she's still my sister. I can't leave her alone with it.
I'm sorry Chef, but no order today. I…need to face my own destiny here. I have to save Eve!
